notes.title: Ducks Can Drive v4.00
notes.content:
Hello ducks,

I have been fairly busy this month, but I have been working on this cosmetic system for v4.00. The infrastructure is now finished, with a handful of cosmetics to choose from. More and more will be added throughout v4.01, v4.02 and onwards. This patch also introduces the Penguins Can Too DLC, which allows you to drive as a penguin if you really want to. The DLC will have a discount for the first week. Expect cosmetics such as different characters along with the penguin like a polar bear and a parrot (in the making at the moment), along with new car models like a buggy and a spaceship to be added. Soon, translations will also be done for the game, which should help its global reach. Autumn (or Fall) is coming (for the northern hemisphere), meaning new themed tracks will also be added soon.

Thank you all for playing Ducks Can Drive, and all who have purchased the supporters pack.
Joey

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Adjusted the exit and settings buttons in the menu
[*] Removed the checkbox from settings for the supporter pack car, and moved it to the cosmetic locker
[*] A new locker menu where you can equip different car colours, car models, duck skins and hats.
[list]
[*] Car colours (apart from red) will be unlocked after finding all the lorebooks
[*] Duck skins (apart from white) will be unlocked through the v1.00-v2.00 track time trials
[*] Duck hats (apart from no hat) will be unlocked through the v3.00+ track time trials
[/list]
[*] Added the Penguins Can Too DLC
[*] Updated the Steam Store and Library assets.
[/list]

notes.title: Servers for Different Regions in Ducks Can Drive
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As of v3.03, you can now select your server region in the settings menu. Currently, these servers include Europe, US and Australia. This should help with any ping, latency and lag issues you may have been experiencing in the multiplayer (before there were only European servers).

If you are trying to play with friends, make sure you are both in the same region in the settings, otherwise you won't be able to find each other's rooms. You know what region you are connected to after going into the multiplayer city menu, as "eu", "us" or "au" will show in the bottom right corner. 

Finally, thank you to all of you who have purchased the supporter pack. It means a lot for the development for the game. More regional servers will be coming soon as the game grows.

Continue to enjoy Ducks Can Drive!
Joey

notes.title: Ducks Can Drive Supporter Pack
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I have recently released the supporter pack for Ducks Can Drive. This is purely a cosmetic change for your duck's car that will appear in all modes (city, time trial and the menu).

If you would like to support Ducks Can Drive's development and multiplayer services, then consider having a look at it, if not, continue to enjoy Ducks Can Drive as is, the experience will not change.

This will also be an initial test for cosmetics, with more coming in the future, being achieved through achievements etc.

notes.title: Ducks Can Drive v3.00!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's not been too long since v2.00, but I decided to do another major update for Ducks Can Drive. Firstly, thank you to everyone who has joined the discord server, the community built there has been amazing. Secondly, thank you to everyone who had good suggestions for the game. I try my best to add these suggestions into updates ASAP. Some main focuses of this patch was a new network system that should remove all bugs with the blue/purple void. The multiplayer now also has a ranked system with matchmaking, so even if you are alone, you can find people to play with. I look forward to seeing you on the race track! (My duck will have a black scarf online). The new private game multiplayer system works by everyone entering the same code to join the same private room.

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] New Network System that removes most multiplayer bugs and blue/purple void bugs.
[*] Ranks, a ranked gamemode to prove your duck driving skills and rank achievements.
[*] Drift boosts have been added along with offroad. Use the spacebar or the right bumper to start a drift and charge a boost.
[*] Boost upgrades and offroad upgrades have been added to the upgrade menu panel. Handling has been removed.
[*] 3 new maps: Wing Circuit, Blackbill Ship and Bill Beach, all with new Time Trial achievements. Good luck!
[*] A certain easter egg involving a yellow fruit has been added, with an achievement for finding it.
[*] A new city map with improved performance has been added.
[*] A new menu UI has been added.
[*] Lorebooks have been added to the map to explain why the bread is so expensive.
[*] Scaling for upgrades has increased significantly.
[*] The placement counter is now more accurate.
[*] Streetlamps and headlights have been added in dark mode.
[*] Checkpoints are now slightly transparent.
[*] Improved general performance.
[*] Rounds and the city timer can now be set to whatever you like.
[/list]

I hope you all enjoy these changes, especially the new rank mode. I will join ranked matches from time to time, so look out for me!

Anybody wondering on why the Time Trial achievements have not been changed with the offroad changes - The times are still possible through the use of extensive drift boosts.

Thank you for playing Ducks Can Drive!
Joey

notes.title: Ducks Can Drive v2.01
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thank you all for the positive feedback on v2.00, and all the good suggestions. Here are the patch notes for version 2.01:

[list]
[*] A new dark mode which can be enabled in settings. This changes the in-game view to be night time, and the UI to be dark.
[*] The duck now sways when turning once again
[*] Players will now preemptively have their position set before loading into the city, to avoid issues with unstable collisions on loading of players
[*] Players will be reset to the correct position when sent to the blue void
[*] Controller is now partially supported! You may still need a mouse to control some UI elements, and is not as fully tested as mouse and keyboard. Expect full controller support soon.
[*] You can now set the amount of rounds up to 99 if you really want to
[/list]

Unfortunately some ideas are still in development as they still have some issues that I need to fix. However, so far, these ideas do give a lot of life to the game. Current ideas in development include: a minimap, different camera angles and wheel support.

As for other things to look forward to, new tracks and a new city is coming soon, along with an overhauled upgrade/customisation system.

I will be taking a short week break on the game, so expect v2.02 on the last week of July.

I hope you continue to enjoy Ducks Can Drive!
Joey

notes.title: Ducks Can Drive v2.00!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

v2.00 is finally here, with the main highlight being the completely new, revamped driving system where it feels like the duck can now actually drive! This is not the only change in this update, as it comes with a variety of bugfixes and cool little things added to make the game feel more whole.

Thank you to everyone who has suggested ideas for the game as this helps a lot with deciding on what to develop next to make the game better.

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Vastly overhauled the driving system and mechanics (the duck can actually drive)
[*] Added smoke and trail effects to the wheels
[*] Fixed a bug where you would not be set to the correct position on the start of a room or race (Hopefully)
[*] The duck now visibly delivers bread to the other ducks
[*] Ramps and curbs are now far easier and more fun to drive across
[*] Added 3 music tracks to the 3 tracks
[*] Added new sound effects for deliveries, checkpoints, laps, race completions and round starts
[*] Slightly lowered the brightness of the game
[*] Players will now have nameplates above their car
[*] Volume settings for music and SFX are now avaliable in settings
[*] The checkpoints are now yellow
[*] You can now collide with trees
[*] Due to the new driving overhaul, the time trial achievement times have been changed, with 35 seconds on Duck Circuit, 40 seconds on Lake Loop and 45 seconds on Quack Crossing
[*] Significantly increased the compass range
[*] The reset button is now UI and is more benefical as it will reset you to your spawn point rather than just reset your rotation
[*] Players will be alerted when a player finishes a race
[*] Improved performance
[/list]

There may be one more update this week, with features like a dark mode and full controller and wheel support. After that I will have a week break from updating the game, but hopefully you continue to enjoy Ducks Can Drive!
Joey

notes.title: Ducks Can Drive v1.05
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you to everyone who has played the game thus far and those who have left a review, it means a lot! Here are the patch notes for v1.05:

[list]
[*] Made it so the owner of the lobby's username will not span out of the screen if too long
[*] Made the car hitbox far more forgiving on ramps and the curb
[*] Added a settings menu in a lobby to set how many rounds you want and how long for (Not fixed at 10 minutes anymore!)
[*] Slightly improved the input detection to improve input delay and input overall
[*] VSync will now save and load properly
[*] Changed the ambient color to be slightly brighter
[*] All cars now have slightly more top speed, but is much harder to go above your top speed briefly when you have a lot of acceleration.
[*] Checkpoints are now rings and not blue squares
[*] Added a lot more background objects on all tracks
[*] Added an exit button to multiplayer
[*] Altered the way the S/Down arrow braking works to be more responsive
[/list]

I am currently working on v2.00, but it's not quite ready yet so I thought I would drop a smaller patch in the meantime. I hope you continue to enjoy Ducks Can Drive!
Joey

notes.title: Ducks Can Drive v1.02
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you to everyone who has downloaded the game so far. Here are the patch notes for version v1.02:
[list]
[*] A new single player Time Trial mode, where you will receive a perfect vehicle while trying to get the best time possible on any track you choose
[*] 3 new achievements for beating certain times in the Time Trial mode
[*] Added a way to reset the rotation of your vehicle with the escape key (Now you won't be stuck forever on your head)
[*] Removed the majority of downward force applied to the car when at high speeds
[*] Braking can now be done with the release of the W key or the S key while moving, rather than just the spacebar
[*] Momentum and velocity will now be reset before loading into a race
[/list]
Feel free to suggest any future update ideas and I will take those into account.
Joey
